scope: Two static photo-estimated candidate layouts; actual transformed native geometry, bounded intersection screening, declared scale/material variants and source hashes. No physics or visual approval.

layouts.method: Exact transformed native mesh vertices; BVH triangle surface overlap after >4mm broad-phase overlap on all axes; both triangles must cross the opposite plane by >0.01mm to exclude coplanar/touch-only support contacts. Not solid containment or physics certification.
